description: Bringhurst's Elements of Typographic Style applied to modern CSS, with claims measured in the browser: measure, leading, vertical rhythm with lh/rlh and text-box, paragraph marking, hyphenation per language, caps spacing, type scales that survive zoom, text vs lining vs tabular figures, true small caps, hard spaces, widows, punctuation, logical properties and RTL that never breaks plus locale conventions for quotes, numbers, units and compound hyphenation (English, Finnish, Swedish). Use whenever you write, review or refactor CSS or HTML that sets text people read: article, docs or blog bodies, type scales and font tokens, headings, captions, tables of numbers, prices, print styles, font loading and OpenType features. Also for "make this more readable", "fix the typography", line-height or max-width questions and multilingual or RTL layout, even when the word typography never appears. Not for drawing letterforms.

results.query: Our docs article body feels cramped and the lines run really long on a desktop monitor. Can you fix prose.css? It's Inter at 17px.
Build a type scale for our design system tokens that stays readable when people zoom to 200%.
We're launching a Hebrew version of the help center. Go through main.css and tell me what will break.
Before I use small caps for acronyms, check whether fonts/Lora-Italic.woff2 actually has them.
Format the prices and file sizes on the Finnish product page so numbers never break away from their units.
Make our blog post template look more editorial: better heading hierarchy, paragraph spacing and pull quotes.
Review the typography in landing.css and give me an honest critique with fixes.
Set up vertical rhythm for our markdown-rendered docs so headings, lists and code blocks sit on a consistent interval.
The numbers in our pricing table don't line up and the minus signs look like hyphens. Fix the CSS.
Swedish body text overflows on phones because of long compound words. What CSS should we use?
Write a Python script that renames every .ttf file in this folder to its font family name.
Set up Tailwind CSS in this Next.js project with the default config.
Turn this CSV of quarterly revenue into a bar chart for the board deck.
Translate these UI strings from English to Finnish and Swedish.
The sidebar collapses to zero width in Safari when the flex container wraps. Find the bug.
Add a dark mode toggle that remembers the user's choice in localStorage.
Design a logo mark for a typography newsletter called Kerning Weekly.
Write Jest unit tests for our date formatting utility.
Create an SVG icon set for the app's bottom navigation.
Write a regex that validates Finnish mobile phone numbers.
